function task(array $times, $d)
{
    $party_time = 0;
    $churu_jokes = 0;
    foreach ($times as $t) {
        $party_time += $t + 10;
        $churu_jokes += 2;
    }

    $party_time -= 10;
    $churu_jokes -= 2;
    $free_time = $d - $party_time;

    if ($party_time > $d or $free_time % 5 != 0) {
        return -1;
    }

    $churu_jokes += $free_time / 5;

    return $churu_jokes;
}

    for ($vy = -1; $vy <= 1; $vy++)

function set_round($x1, $y1, $x2, $y2, &$area) {
    if($x2==7 && $y2==0) {
        die('WIN');
    }
    else {
        $area[$y1][$x1] = '.';
        $area[$y2][$x2] = 'M';
    }
    move_enemy($area);
}

function move_enemy(&$area) {
    for($x=0;$x<8;$x++) {
        for($y=7;$y>=0;$y--) {
            if(in_array($area[$y][$x], array('S'))) {
                $area[$y][$x] = '.';
                if($y+1 <= 7) {
                    if(in_array($area[$y+1][$x], array('M'))) {
                        die('LOSE');
                    }
                    $area[$y+1][$x] = 'S';
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

function is_free_point($x,$y, $area) {
    if(valid_point($x, $y)) {
        if(in_array($area[$y][$x], array('.','A','M'))) {
            return TRUE;
        }
    }
    return FALSE;
}

function is_danger_point($x,$y,$area) {
    if( valid_point($x,($y-1) ) === FALSE || is_free_point($x, ($y-1) , $area) ) {
        return FALSE;
    }
    return TRUE;
}

function valid_point($x,$y) {
    if($x > 7 || $y > 7 || $x < 0 || $y < 0) {
        return FALSE;
    }
    return TRUE;
}

$contents           = stream_get_contents($dir);
$inputs             = explode("\n",$contents);
$problemsCount      = substr($inputs[0], 0, 1);
$solverSkill        = substr($inputs[0], 2);
$problemDifficulty  = array_map('intval', explode(' ', $inputs[1]));
echo getMaximumProblems($problemsCount, $problemDifficulty, $solverSkill);

function getMaximumProblems($problemsCount, $problemDifficulty, $solverSkill)
{
    $maximumSolvedProblems    = 0;
    $firstProblemDifficulty   = $problemDifficulty[0];
    $lastProblemDifficulty    = $problemDifficulty[$problemsCount - 1];
    if($firstProblemDifficulty > $solverSkill && $lastProblemDifficulty  > $solverSkill)
    {
        return 0;
    }
    
    for($problemsCounter = 0; $problemsCounter < $problemsCount; $problemsCounter++)
    {
        if($problemDifficulty[$problemsCounter] <= $solverSkill)
        {
            $maximumSolvedProblems++;
            unset($problemDifficulty[$problemsCounter]);
        }
        
        if($problemDifficulty[$problemsCounter] > $solverSkill)
        {
            break;
        }
    }
    
    if(count($problemDifficulty) > 0) {
        $reversedArray  = array_reverse($problemDifficulty);
        for($problemsCounter = 0; $problemsCounter < count($problemDifficulty); $problemsCounter++)
        {
             if($reversedArray[$problemsCounter] <= $solverSkill)
            {
                $maximumSolvedProblems++;
                unset($reversedArray[$problemsCounter]);
            }
            
            if($reversedArray[$problemsCounter] > $solverSkill)
            {
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    
    return $maximumSolvedProblems;
}

function ropewalkers($str = '')
{
    $arr = explode(' ', $str);
    $d = $arr[count($arr)-1];
    unset($arr[count($arr)-1]);

    $result = 0;
    sort($arr);
    for ($i = 0; $i < count($arr); $i++) {
        if (isset($arr[$i+1]) && abs($arr[$i] - $arr[$i+1]) < $d) {
            $result += $d - abs(($arr[$i] - $arr[$i+1]));
        }
    }
    return $result;
}

error_reporting(E_ALL);

function readString($f) {
	$r = array(
		"\r" => '',
		"\n" => '',
	);
	return strtr(fgets($f), $r);
}

function readNumString($f) {
	return trim(fgets($f));
}

function stringToArray($str) {
	return str_split($str);
}

function readNum($f, $is_int = false) {
	$v = readNumString($f);
	return $is_int ? intval($v) : floatval($v);
}

function readStringExplode($f, $delimiter = ' ') {
	$v = readNumString($f);
	if ($delimiter == '') {
		$return = stringToArray($v);
	} else {
		$return = explode($delimiter, $v);
	}
	$callf = 'trim';
	return array_map($callf, $return);
}

function readStringExplodeNum($f, $delimiter = ' ', $is_int = false) {
	$v = readNumString($f);
	if ($delimiter == '') {
		$return = stringToArray($v);
	} else {
		$return = explode($delimiter, $v);
	}
	$callf = $is_int ? 'intval' : 'floatval';
	return array_map($callf, $return);
}

			if ($a[$i][$j] == $d) {
				$dem++;
			}
		}
	}
	return $dem;
}



function checkwin($a, $b, $c, $d) {
	return ($a == $d && $b == $d && $c == $d);
}

function checkwin2($a, $b, $c, $d) {
	return checkwin($a[0], $a[1], $a[2], $d) || checkwin($b[0], $b[1], $b[2], $d) || checkwin($c[0], $c[1], $c[2], $d) || checkwin($a[0], $b[0], $c[0], $d) || checkwin($a[1], $b[1], $c[1], $d) || checkwin($a[2], $b[2], $c[2], $d) || checkwin($a[0], $b[1], $c[2], $d) || checkwin($a[2], $b[1], $c[0], $d);
}

	$dem1 = demX($a, 'X');
	$dem2 = demX($a, '0');
	if ($dem1 - $dem2 > 1 || $dem2 - $dem1 > 1) {
		return "illegal";

function fullRow($array, $rowNum, $sign) {
    $index = $rowNum * 3;
    
    if ($array[$index] == $sign && $array[$index + 1] == $sign && $array[$index + 2] == $sign) return true;
    else return false;
}

function fullCol($array, $colNum, $sign) {
    if ($array[$colNum] == $sign && $array[$colNum + 3] == $sign && $array[$colNum + 6] == $sign) return true;
    else return false;
} 

function fullDiag1($array, $sign) {
    if ($array[0] == $sign && $array[4] == $sign && $array[8] == $sign) return true; 
    else return false;
} 

function fullDiag2($array, $sign) {
    if ($array[2] == $sign && $array[4] == $sign && $array[6] == $sign) return true; 
    else return false;
}

function g($single = false) {

	global $stdin;

	$input = explode(" ", trim(fgets($stdin)));

function set_bits($n, $dn, &$a) {
	if ($n == 0) {
		$a[0] += $dn;
		return ($a[0] < 2);
	}
	global $powers;
	$i = 0;
	for($i = 0; $i < $dn; ++$i) {		
		$d = $n%$powers[$i];
		//echo "$n%$powers[$i] = $d\n";
		if (++$a[$d] > 1) {
			return false;
		}
		if (!$d && $n) {
			$n -= $powers[$i];
		} else {
			$n -= $d;
		}
	}
	return true;
}

function calc($n){
	if($n == 1){
		return 1;
	} else {

		$check = function($n, $div){
			$s = floor(sqrt($div));
			for($j = 2; $j <= $s; $j++){
				if($div % $j == 0){
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		};
		$primeDivs = [];

		$s = floor(sqrt($n));
		for($div = 2; $div <= $s; $div++){
			if($n % $div == 0) {
				if ($check($n, $div)){
					$primeDivs[] = $div;
					if(count($primeDivs) == 2) {break;}
				}
			}
		}
		// echo $n.' ['.implode(' ', $primeDivs).'] ';
	}
	if(count($primeDivs) == 0){
		return $n;
	} else if(count($primeDivs) == 1){
		return $primeDivs[0];
	} else {
		return 1;
	}
}

function calc($n){

	if($n == 1){
		return 1;
	} else {
		$primeDivs = [];
		for($i = 2; $i <= floor($n / 2); $i++){
			if($n % $i == 0 ){
				$isPrime = true;
				for($j = 2; $j<=floor($i / 2); $j++){
					if($i % $j == 0){
						$isPrime = false;
						break;
					}
				}
				if($isPrime){
					$primeDivs[] = $i;
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if(count($primeDivs) == 0){
		return $n;
	} else if(count($primeDivs) == 1){
		return $primeDivs[0];
	} else {
		return 1;
	}
}

function readString($f) {
	$r = array(
		"\r" => '',
		"\n" => '',
	);
	return strtr(fgets($f), $r);
}

function readNumString($f) {
	return trim(fgets($f));
}

function stringToArray($str) {
	return str_split($str);
}

function readNum($f, $is_int = false) {
	$v = readNumString($f);
	return $is_int ? intval($v) : floatval($v);
}

function readStringExplode($f, $delimiter = ' ') {
	$v = readNumString($f);
	if ($delimiter == '') {
		$return = stringToArray($v);
	} else {
		$return = explode($delimiter, $v);
	}
	$callf = 'trim';
	return array_map($callf, $return);
}

function readStringExplodeNum($f, $delimiter = ' ', $is_int = false) {
	$v = readNumString($f);
	if ($delimiter == '') {
		$return = stringToArray($v);
	} else {
		$return = explode($delimiter, $v);
	}
	$callf = $is_int ? 'intval' : 'floatval';
	return array_map($callf, $return);
}

class InputReader {
	protected $_fh;
	
	public function __construct($fileHandler = STDIN) 
	{
		$this->_fh = $fileHandler;
	}
	
	public function readInt() 
	{
		$d = trim(fgets($this->_fh));
		
		return (int)$d;
	}
	
	public function readArrayOfInt($size, $indexFrom = 0) 
	{
		$a = [];
		$ind = $indexFrom;
		foreach (explode(' ', fgets($this->_fh)) as $item) {
			$a[$ind++] = (int)$item;
		}
		
		return $a;
	}
	
	public function readArrayOfString($size, $indexFrom = 0) 
	{
		$a = [];
		$ind = $indexFrom;
		foreach (explode(' ', fgets($this->_fh)) as $item) {
			$a[$ind++] = $item;
		}
		
		return $a;
	}
}

function ntimes($n, $func, $returnResults = false) {
	$a = [];
	for ($i=1; $i<=$n; $i++) {
		$result = $func();
		
		if ($returnResults) {
			$a[$i] = $result;
		}
	}
	
	return $a;
}

function isPalindromeWithOneChange($s) {
	if (strlen($s) == 1) {
		return true;
	}
	$sArr = str_split($s);
	$left = 0;
	$right = count($sArr) - 1;
	$changes = 0;
	while($left < $right) {
		if ($sArr[$left] != $sArr[$right]) {
			$changes++;
		}
		$left++;
		$right--;
	}

	return $changes == 1;
}

function all_divisors($n) {
  $divs = array();
  for ($i = 2; $i <= sqrt($n); ) {
    if ($n % $i == 0) {
      @$divs[$i]++;
      $n /= $i;
    } else {
      $i++;
    }
  }
  if ($n != 1 || empty($divs)) {
    @$divs[$n]++;
  }
  return $divs;
}

function next_comb(&$comb, $orders, $pos = 0) {
  if ($pos >= count($comb)) {
    return false;
  }
  $comb[$pos]++;
  if ($comb[$pos] > $orders[$pos]) {
    $comb[$pos] = 0;
    return next_comb($comb, $orders, $pos + 1);
  }
  return true;
}

  echo "infinity\n";

  echo "0\n";

    foreach ($comb as $i => $count) {
      $tryN *= pow($divisors[$i], $count);
    }
    if ($tryN > $b) {
      $ok++;
    }
  } while (next_comb($comb, $orders));

}

		"\r" => '',

	);

function readNumString($f) {
	return trim(fgets($f));

function stringToArray($str) {
	return str_split($str);
}

function readNum($f, $is_int = false) {
	$v = readNumString($f);
	return $is_int ? intval($v) : floatval($v);
}

function readStringExplode($f, $delimiter = ' ') {
	$v = readNumString($f);
	if ($delimiter == '') {
		$return = stringToArray($v);
	} else {
		$return = explode($delimiter, $v);
	}
	$callf = 'trim';
	return array_map($callf, $return);
}

function readStringExplodeNum($f, $delimiter = ' ', $is_int = false) {
	$v = readNumString($f);
	if ($delimiter == '') {
		$return = stringToArray($v);
	} else {
		$return = explode($delimiter, $v);
	}
	$callf = $is_int ? 'intval' : 'floatval';

function Capslock($input){
    $output =   "";
    $string_length = strlen($input);
    $string_except_first_letter =   substr($input, 1, $string_length);
  
    if($string_length==1){
        $output = strtoupper($input);
    }
    elseif (ctype_upper($input)){
        $output = strtolower($input);
    }
    else{
        if( ctype_upper($string_except_first_letter)){
                $output     = strtoupper($input[0]).strtolower($string_except_first_letter);
        }
        else {
            $output =   $input;
        }
    }
   
    return $output;
}

function canRejoin($str)
{
    $links  = 0;
    $pearls = 0;
    foreach (str_split($str, 1) as $ch){
        if($ch === '-'){
            $links++;
        }
        elseif($ch === 'o'){
            $pearls++;
        }
    }
    return $links % $pearls == 0;
}

function main()
{
    $str = fread(STDIN, 4096);
    echo canRejoin($str)? 'YES':'NO';
}

function abbreviateWord($word) {

    $vowels = array("a", "o", "y", "e", "u", "i");
    $result = array();

    foreach ($str_split($word) as $w) {
        if (!in_array($w, $vowels)) {
            $result[] = $w;
        }
    }

    return "." . implode(".", $result);
}

	//$Scanner = new Scanner("input.txt");
	
	$N = (int)$Scanner->Scan();
	$X = (int)$Scanner->Scan();
	$Y = (int)$Scanner->Scan();

	$temp = ceil($temp);
	$need = $temp - $X;
	
	print($need);
	
	$Scanner->Close();
}

class Scanner{
	private $Stream;
	private $Scanners = array();
	private $Id = 0;
	
	public function __construct($opend){
		$this->Stream = fopen($opend, 'r');
		$contents = stream_get_contents($this->Stream);
		$contents = str_replace(array("\r\n", "\r", "\n"), " ", $contents);
		$this->Scanners = explode(" ", $contents);
	}
	
	public function Scan(){
		return $this->Scanners[$this->Id++];
	}

	public function Close(){
		fclose($this->Stream);
	}
}

function twobases($input){
    $inarr = explode("\n",$input);
    $bases1 = explode(" ",$inarr[0]);
    $digits1 = explode(" ",$inarr[1]);
    $bases2 = explode(" ",$inarr[2]);
    $digits2 = explode(" ",$inarr[3]);

    $val1 = 0;
    $c1 = count($digits1);
    $base1 = intval($bases1[1]);
    for($i=0;$i<$c1; $i++){
        $val1 += intval($digits1[$c1-$i-1]) * pow($base1,$i);
    }

    $val2 = 0;
    $c2 = count($digits2);
    $base2 = intval($bases2[1]);
    for($i=0;$i<$c2; $i++){
        $val2 += intval($digits2[$c2-$i-1]) * pow($base2,$i);
    }

    echo $val1."\r\n";
    echo $val2."\r\n";

    if($val1 == $val2){
        return "=";
    }else if($val1 > $val2){
        return ">";
    }else{
        return "<";
    }
}

$stdin = fopen('php://stdin', 'r');

$a = str_split(fgets($stdin));
$b = str_split(fgets($stdin));

$base = ord('a') - ord('A');

$orda = ord('a');

$len = count($a);
$ords = array();

$result = 0;

for($i = 0; $i < $len; $i++)
{
	if(!isset($ords[$a[$i]]))
	{
		$ai = ord($a[$i]);

		if($ai >= $orda)
		{
			$ai -= $base;
		} 
		
		$ords[$a[$i]] = $ai;
	}
	
	$ai = $ords[$a[$i]];
	
	if(!isset($ords[$b[$i]]))
	{
		$bi = ord($b[$i]);

		if($bi >= $orda)
		{
			$bi -= $base;
		} 
		
		$ords[$b[$i]] = $bi;
	}
	
	$bi = $ords[$b[$i]];
		
	if($ai > $bi)
	{
		$result =  1;
		break;
	}elseif($ai < $bi)
	{
		$result = -1;
	}
}

echo $result;
